name: Catch Brainrots From River
desc:
🎣 Welcome to Catch Brainrots from River!

🎮 How to Play:

🔧 Equip your fishing rod
🌊 Click on the brainrots floating down the river
💥 Keep clicking to reel them in, don't forget the critical hits!
🏠 Bring them to your base
💰 Earn money and buy better rods!


❤️ If you enjoyed the game, don't forget to like and join the group!
❤️ Credit to @WinnersTakesAll for the backpack system!
